game.name: Soldier Of Fortune : Payback (USA)
game.desc: Soldier of Fortune 3: Payback on Xbox 360 puts you in the ranks of Private Mason after he's been double-crossed in a mission. Now it's time for revenge and you have to take justice into your own hands while filling terrorists with lead who know no limits. A first-person shooter, the software allows you to choose your arsenal at the beginning of each level to adapt it to the situation.
